intent: 3BR / 2 bath bedroom-lobby-hub MINIMUM-boundary smoke test, no carport. 11x12.25 lot gives a 7x7.75 envelope = 54.25 m² floor — the tightest squarish (1:1-ish) lot found feasible for this topology (bisected 2026-08-06: 11x11 infeasible, 11x12.25 compliant). br2+br3 pair on one hub wall, master alone on a second, common bath on a third, hub open to the great_room on the fourth; ensuite off master. Kitchen shares a wet_core wall with the common bath. No zone_split (private rooms wrap the hub on multiple sides rather than forming a column) and left_anchored/right_anchored are both null by design — this brief exercises that the topology still solves without them at its tightest known-feasible size.
must_haves: central bedroom-lobby hub, no separate hallway run
